darren: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — quick follow-ups, links, and owners below.
darren: Recording: https://redwood.app/ah/247901 — Slides: https://drive.google.com/redwood/ah-may
darren: NOTE: I’m collecting owners here so we can track in the follow-ups doc.

darren: Action: Dedicated GA timeline — owner @raj. Please confirm final week by EOW.
raj: Confirming provisional GA target: week of May 6. Will lock dates after release checklist pass.
raj: Canary plan: adding canary + automatic fallback to smaller variant; details in release checklist.
raj: Canary rollout command example:
```
rwctl rollout create --model rdw/dedicated-v1 --canary 10% --metric latency
```

emily: Quick product clarification from q&a — Optimize features: shipping as an add-on at GA, but we’ll open early access for a subset of customers.
emily: I’ll also draft a short billing explainer so early customers understand add-on pricing.

sophia: Two leadership asks: 1) Don’t compromise SLA/rollback safety for speed; 2) Run a 2-week blackbox test before GA sign-off.
sophia: We should also make billing transparency a top priority for early adopter accounts.

marta: DevEx will ship a Dedicated + Private quickstart template by Tue. I’ll open a docs PR and tag reviewers.
marta: Reminder to teams — keep examples minimal and copy-paste friendly for customers.

growth-lead: We’ll collect prompt sets from two pilot teams and share sample eval prompts by Fri. Owner: @growth-team.
growth-lead: Also will surface customer interest in on‑prem packaging to Sales.

security-bot: New ticket created: RDW-3458 — KMS provider matrix. Link: https://issues.redwood/3458
security-bot: Security will own the provider list and ensure KMS integration docs are ready for GA.

salesbot: Sales note: please add interested customers to RDW-PACKING sheet: https://sheets.redwood/packing
salesbot: I updated the sheet with three enterprise leads who asked about onprem packaging.

darren: Performance target clarification from the all-hands: p95 < 350ms for typical chat workloads on Dedicated (with default batching). Owner: @eng-sre to validate across hardware profiles.
raj: We’ll add perf regression checks to the CI that gate canary progress.

emily: Prompt evaluation plan — short checklist: 1) baseline prompts; 2) quality thresholds; 3) regression alert hooks. I’ll share a template Wed.

darren: TL;DR action items (tracked in the follow-ups doc):
- Raj: lock GA week and post release checklist (due EOW)
- Emily: billing explainer + Optimize add-on clarification (Wed)
- Marta/DevEx: quickstart template + docs PR (Tue)
- Security: KMS matrix ticket RDW-3458 (ongoing)
- Growth/Sales: collect prompt sets and onprem interest (Fri)
- Eng-SRE: validate p95 target across hardware profiles (next 7 days)

darren: Ping me or drop comments in the Notion doc if you want to be re-assigned.:hand:
sophia: Appreciate the follow-up and owners — thanks team! :heart:
raj: I’ll start a separate thread for the release checklist tomorrow so we have a dedicated place for checklist comments.
marta: Will tag docs reviewers once the PR is up.
darren: Closing this thread and updating the tracking doc: https://notion.redwood/ah-followups/247901 - I’ll post a short status update after each owner closes their item.
